message: Last week, we had a little storm scare in our neighborhood. I took a peek at some resources on hurricane preparedness, just in case we needed to make sure our family was ready for anything. I found a few tips that turned out to be small wins — like checking batteries and having snacks on hand. It’s funny how a bit of planning can make you feel like a superhero, even if it’s just for a few raindrops. How do you keep your family prepared for unexpected weather?
